settings.youtubeApiCredentialsPlaceholder: Select a JSON file containing an API key
settings.youtubeApiCredentialsHint: Top-comment downloads use YouTube Data API v3. Google does not support service-account identities for YouTube; the selected JSON must contain an API key such as api_key or youtube_api_key. A service-account JSON is accepted only if you add an API key field to it.
settings.youtubeServiceAccountUnsupported: Google service accounts cannot authenticate YouTube Data API calls. Add an API key field (api_key or youtube_api_key) to the JSON, or use a separate API-key JSON file.
settings.youtubeApiKeyMissing: No YouTube Data API key was found in that JSON file.

detail.downloadTopCommentsYoutubeOnly: Available for YouTube video URLs only
detail.youtubeApiCredentialsRequired: Choose a YouTube API credentials JSON file in Settings first
